rounds.name: Recruiter Screen
rounds.focus: Motivation, mission alignment, resume walkthrough. India note: Anthropic announced its first India office in Bengaluru (opening early 2026, led by India MD Irina Ghose); India-specific PM hiring is nascent and roles have mostly been filled via SF/remote-US postings to date, so expect the process to still be forming and largely virtual for India-based candidates.
questions: Why Anthropic, and what draws you to AI safety?
Walk me through your resume and the products you've led
How does Anthropic's mission resonate with you personally?
What do you know about Claude and Anthropic's product suite?
What other AI companies are you interviewing with, and why Anthropic over them?

rounds.name: Hiring Manager Conversation
rounds.format: 45-60 min video call with the hiring manager
rounds.focus: Depth on shipped products, metrics ownership, and judgment from past failures
questions: Tell me about recent products you've led and the KPIs you owned
Walk me through a failure and what you learned from it
If your team described you in one word, what would it be and why?
Tell me about a product decision you made that you'd reverse today
How do you decide what NOT to build?
What's the hardest trade-off you've had to make as a PM?

rounds.name: Product / Business Case
rounds.format: 45-60 min case interview, sometimes folded into the panel day
rounds.focus: Ambiguous product/strategy prompt specific to AI products
rounds.evaluates: Structured thinking under ambiguity, AI product judgment, safety-aware reasoning
questions: How would you define success metrics for a new Claude feature that balances user value and risk?
How do you approach safety trade-offs in a consumer-facing AI product?
How would you handle a Claude feature that gives confident but incorrect answers in high-stakes contexts?
How would you prioritize capability improvements versus safety improvements on the same roadmap?
Design a Claude feature for a specific enterprise use case (e.g., legal or healthcare)
How would you decide whether a new model capability should ship to consumers immediately or be gated?
What would you build next for Claude, and why?

rounds.name: Cross-Functional Panel
rounds.format: Multiple back-to-back interviews on the same day with PMs, engineers, researchers, and designers
rounds.evaluates: Collaboration, influence without authority, technical partnership
questions: Tell me about a time you drove alignment across teams that disagreed
How do you prioritize competing feature requests under resource constraints?
Describe a time you influenced a decision you didn't own
How do you work with research/engineering teams when timelines are uncertain (e.g., model training)?
Tell me about a time you had to say no to an engineering partner
How do you communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders?

rounds.name: Culture / Values Interview
rounds.format: ~45 min standalone interview, often with a non-technical interviewer
rounds.focus: Values, intellectual honesty, conviction under discomfort
rounds.evaluates: Values alignment, intellectual honesty, willingness to defend beliefs
questions: What slightly unusual beliefs do you hold, and how have you defended them in uncomfortable situations?
Tell me about a time you did something that conflicted with your values
Describe a time you changed your mind about something you felt strongly about
How would you weigh values against commercial pressure in a product decision?
What concerns do you have about Anthropic's direction or approach?
Who do you respect but disagree with on values, and why?
How do you think about AI safety trade-offs personally, beyond the company line?

rounds.name: Recruiter Screen
rounds.focus: Background, scale of past programs, motivation. Note: Anthropic does not run a distinct branded APM/TPM rotational program the way Google or Amazon do; job titles are simply 'Program Manager' or 'Technical Program Manager' and the process is notably fast, often compressed into one week of final-round conversations.
questions: Tell me about yourself and the programs you've run
Why Anthropic, and why now?
What's the largest/most complex program you've delivered end-to-end?
What's your experience with research operations or infrastructure scaling programs, if any?
Why are you interested in moving from [current company/industry] to an AI safety lab?

rounds.name: Hiring Manager Screen
rounds.focus: Core program management fundamentals and technical literacy
rounds.evaluates: Program management fundamentals, technical literacy, domain-specific execution
questions: Tell me about a time you had a conflict with someone and how you resolved it
How do you prioritize tasks across multiple competing programs?
Tell me about a time you received negative feedback and how you handled it
Describe the most technically complex project you've worked on and why it was complex
How would you explain a technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder?
Tell me about your interest in AI and what you know about Anthropic's approach

rounds.name: Program Management & Technical Execution
rounds.format: 45-60 min panel or 1:1 with a peer Program Manager or engineer
rounds.focus: Risk management, resource planning, milestone tracking for technical/research programs
rounds.evaluates: Execution rigor, risk management, technical partnership
questions: Walk me through how you'd structure a program for a complex software launch under a tight deadline
Tell me about a time you had to deliver negative feedback to a partner team
Describe a time you had to pivot a plan mid-execution when priorities changed
How do you track and communicate risk on a program with many unknowns (e.g., involving model training timelines)?
Tell me about a time you took on a task outside your job description to unblock a program
How do you balance protecting team focus against responding to urgent, high-priority asks?

rounds.name: Cross-Functional Partner Panel
rounds.format: Back-to-back interviews with engineering and research partners
rounds.evaluates: Collaboration, communication, ability to structure chaotic environments
questions: Tell me about a time you led a cross-functional team through ambiguity
How do you encourage collaboration among teams that don't naturally talk to each other?
Describe a time you had to convince team members to adopt an approach they initially resisted
How do you handle a research/engineering dependency that's slipping with no clear owner?
Tell me about a time you protected a team's focus from scope creep

rounds.name: Culture / Values Interview
rounds.format: 45 min standalone interview; commonly reported as the round where most candidates are screened out
rounds.evaluates: Values alignment, judgment under pressure, honesty
questions: How do you think about delivering results quickly without sacrificing safety or quality?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a decision on ethical or safety grounds
What would you do if you were asked to accelerate a timeline in a way that felt risky?
Describe a belief you hold that most of your peers would disagree with
What concerns, if any, do you have about working at an AI safety lab?
